params.name: publicationId
params.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description:
Pagination returns the results in pages. Each page contains the number of results specified by the `limit` (default: 10).
If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

params.name: order
params.description: The direction of the request. Defaults to `asc`.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The field to order by. Defaults to `created`.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of post templates available for the publication.
